maddie bay.bio: Maddie Bay is a France-born, Montréal-based singer-songwriter, vocalist and producer whose alternative pop-folk blends delicate acoustic writing with electronic textures. Her professional bio identifies Maddie Bay as her artist project and notes that she has been living in Canada for several years. Her 2026 single fin pm is her Northern Dial library credit.

jugger.bio: JUGGER is a Toronto hip-hop artist whose dark, high-energy rap catalogue spans solo work and a long-running creative partnership with Toronto producer WondaGurl. Their 2025 project BABA YAGA 2 includes several of JUGGER's six Northern Dial library tracks, alongside singles such as DIPSET and HELTER SKELTER.

kai banks.bio: Kai Banks is a rapper and recording artist in London, Ontario's 4DaTribe collective, part of a new generation of Canadian hip-hop artists emerging from the city. His solo catalogue includes The Kaible and 08 JETTA, while Too Deep For The Outro with La Reezy and Mileena is his Northern Dial library credit.

lais.bio: Lais is a Toronto-based R&B singer and rapper whose moody independent catalogue drew early attention from OVO Sound Radio. Releases including SESSION ONE, Give Me One More and the 2018 single Once account for his four Northern Dial library credits.

mcmaster.bio: McMaster is the split Northern Dial credit for Canadian singer-songwriter Luke McMaster, one half of Winnipeg pop and R&B duo McMaster & James with Rob James. The duo's gold-selling Canadian run produced radio hits including Thank You, the exact McMaster credit represented in the Northern Dial library.
